projects.title: É de Chão
projects.description: Café site for São Paulo: live menu, bookings, and a staff admin.
projects.longDescription: Cafés around me were stuck between Instagram, WhatsApp bookings, and a menu in a spreadsheet. I built É de Chão so guests see the live menu, whether the house is open in São Paulo time, and can reserve a table without leaving the site. Staff edit menu, hours, discounts, blog, and bookings behind Auth.js. Shipped with Next.js, Neon, and Drizzle on Vercel.

projects.title: VetPay
projects.description: Tele-vet demo with client pets/appointments and a small admin CRM.
projects.longDescription: VetPay is where I practiced roles properly. Marketing pages sit in front; signed-in clients manage their own pets and appointments; admins get a CRM. NextAuth (email/password + Google) redirects by role, and server actions check that you only touch your own records. Next.js App Router, Neon, Drizzle, Zod.

projects.title: Lumen Desk
projects.description: Desk-setup shop that checks out with Stripe and lists paid orders.
projects.longDescription: Lumen Desk is a small commerce slice built to prove a real Stripe path. Products live in Neon; the cart stays in localStorage; Checkout Sessions are created on the server; checkout.session.completed writes the paid order. Locally that needs stripe listen; production uses the Vercel webhook. Admin stays thin: password, search, filters, order detail.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I’m a front-end developer focused on React and Next.js — Figma to production UI with Tailwind and TypeScript. I also handle the server side the product needs (Auth.js, Neon/Drizzle, server actions, Stripe webhooks), still growing there, with the UI as my home base.

Before tech I spent 3+ years in restaurant and delivery ops: leading teams, customer service, sales, and training. That background is why I care about clear flows, not only pretty screens — menus, bookings, and admin tools people can use under pressure.
The projects here (café site, tele-vet, Stripe shop) are how I practice shipping that end to end. I’m looking for a front-end role where I keep building real product UI with a strong team.
